headline: OpenAI Appoints Former US Army Secretary to National Security Role
summary: OpenAI appointed former U.S. Army secretary Dan Driscoll to a newly created position focused on advancing artificial intelligence in national security.
why: OpenAI is a prominent artificial intelligence research and deployment company. Expanding into national security applications can open new government contracting opportunities and shape defense-related AI policy.

impacts.name: OpenAI
impacts.why: Appointment of a national security executive expands OpenAI's government-focused initiatives.
